description: Definition of Done used by Agent 1. A project is READY_FOR_FINAL_REVIEW only when every condition holds. Evaluated deterministically by `python -m grader readiness`.
notes: must_pass covers: verified citations, no data leakage, code matches report, claims supported, reproducible environment and scripts, README.
An integrity risk level of NEEDS_REVIEW does not block readiness (it is only a signal), but HIGH_CONCERN does until a human has reviewed it.
